newsitem.title: USA: Louden County, Tenn., sales taxes approved.
newsitem.headline: Louden County, Tenn., sales taxes approved.

text.p: Louden County approved a sales tax for its parks, but its Lenoir City defeated a tax for schools, election officials said.
In Louden County, about 30 miles south of Knoxville, residents approved the one cent sales tax for parks with 601 voters approving and 541 disapproving, the election official said.
The Louden County sales tax will go from 7.5 percent to 8.5 percent and local press reports said the increase will generate about $400,000 per year.
In Lenoir City in Louden County, voters turned down a one- half cent increase in the sales tax which would have funded a school building program. The measure drew 1,142 no votes and 879 yes votes.
